name: Smithery
summary: Public (non-proxied) MCP registry and directory of MCP servers, powered by Arcade.dev since Smithery's MCP Proxy and managed identity shut down on October 31, 2026.
description: Smithery's MCP Proxy and managed identity shut down on October 31, 2026: “we're shutting down Smithery's connection management services. Smithery will remain as a public (non-proxied) MCP registry.” What stopped working: server URLs on run.tools and server.smithery.ai; the Smithery API, Connect, and Toolbox; Smithery accounts and API keys; and the Smithery CLI and SDKs (“We'll mark the current versions as deprecated”). smithery.ai stays as a public directory of MCP servers, now powered by Arcade.dev, and verified servers list their direct MCP URLs (e.g. mcp.linear.app/mcp). Smithery refunded every charge since August 5.
